subject: Pricing follow-up: $/1M token target + multi-year sweetener options
messages:
From: Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwoodinference.com>
To: Sylvia Tran <sylvia@novaai.com>
Cc: Neha Kapoor <neha.kapoor@redwoodinference.com>, Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Sun, 01 Nov 2026 15:12:00 -0800
Subject: Pricing follow-up: $/1M token target + multi-year sweetener options

Sylvia — great to meet today. Quick recap and proposed next steps from our side after the demo: 

- Signal: NovaAI expects ~14M prompt tokens /mo in month 1 of paid usage, trending to ~45M/mo by month 6 based on the MAU and usage patterns we walked through. I attached a quick token burn estimate (novaai_token_burn_estimate.xlsx).
- Ask: you mentioned an internal target of ~$350 per 1M tokens for the initial phase to make the model economics work. Can you confirm that target range ($/1M) is the bar we should aim for when putting together committed terms?
- Discounts: you asked about startup-program credit + committed-use discounts. If the target is $350/1M, a plausible path is: founder credit for first 2 months, then a 12-month committed tier with blended $/1M that hits the target. Alternatively, we can evaluate a 6mo pilot (paid) followed by a 12- or 24-mo commitment with escalating discounts.

Next steps I propose:
1) Sylvia — confirm the $/1M target range (is $300–$400 acceptable or narrow to a single target?). Also flag any mandatory procurement/legal requirements (PO, SLA, security checklist timeline).
2) Ben / Neha — can you draft a committed-use quote and a two-option sweetener (12mo and 24mo) that aims at the $350/1M midpoint? Please include an option that layers a small founder credit or one-time invoice credit for early-stage customers.
3) If we can agree on target economics, I’ll schedule a brief follow-up (30m) with NovaAI procurement next week to validate procurement timeline and signatures.

Attachments: novaai_token_burn_estimate.xlsx (spreadsheet, estimated token burn by feature)

Thanks — Marcus
Marcus Lin
Senior Sales Lead, Redwood Inference
marcus.lin@redwoodinference.com
+1 (415) 555-0123
From: Sylvia Tran <sylvia@novaai.com>
To: Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: NovaAI procurement <procurement@novaai.com>
Date: Sun, 01 Nov 2026 18:05:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Pricing follow-up: $/1M token target + multi-year sweetener options

Marcus — thanks for the recap and estimate. Confirming a few points:

- Target: yes, our finance lead is looking for a target in the neighborhood of $300–$400 per 1M tokens for the initial production phase. $350/1M is a good anchor to use for proposals.
- Budget: we have an initial budget allocation of ~$120k for the first 6 months of inference spend (not including infra/infra labor). That implies we need to tune commitment and cadence to fit that runway — e.g., start with a lower committed entry and scale via bursts or reserve slots.
- Procurement: procurement will require a PO, standard 45-day net payment terms (we can negotiate), and a short SOC2 attestation (we can share our vendor security checklist next day).

We’re very interested in the multi-year sweetener if it reduces unit economics meaningfully — especially if you can layer a founder or early-customer credit to offset initial burn. Happy to have a 30m call with procurement next week.

— Sylvia
Sylvia Tran, Head of Product
NovaAI
sylvia@novaai.com
From: Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwoodinference.com>
To: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwoodinference.com>, Neha Kapoor <neha.kapoor@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Sylvia Tran <sylvia@novaai.com>
Date: Mon, 02 Nov 2026 08:30:00 -0800
Subject: Fwd: Pricing follow-up: $/1M token target + multi-year sweetener options

Ben / Neha — forwarding Sylvia’s confirmation. "$300–$400 per 1M, $350 is our anchor; budget ~$120k first 6 months; procurement needs PO + SOC2 attestation".

Ask: can you put together two tidy options we can present to NovaAI:
A) 12-month committed-use: goal blended price = $350/1M (show list price, committed discount %, effective blended $/1M). Include founder credit that phases out over first 2 paid months (one-time invoice credit).
B) 24-month committed-use: deeper discount/slot reservation so blended $/1M is ~20% lower than option A in year 1 (show uplift assumptions).

Also include a 6mo paid pilot fallback (no commit, slightly higher per-1M), so procurement can see a lower barrier entry. Attach a draft quote (draft-commit-quote.pdf) and a short note for legal on the SOW points procurement will insist on (PO, payment terms, data access limits).

Timeline: ideally have a short deck + quote by EOD Wednesday so I can run it in the call with procurement on Thurs. If pricing needs more time, propose the earliest ready slot.

Thanks — Marcus

> On Nov 1, 2026, at 18:05, Sylvia Tran <sylvia@novaai.com> wrote:
> > Marcus — thanks for the recap and estimate...
From: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwoodinference.com>
To: Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwoodinference.com>, Neha Kapoor <neha.kapoor@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Sylvia Tran <sylvia@novaai.com>
Date: Mon, 02 Nov 2026 10:03:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Pricing follow-up: $/1M token target + multi-year sweetener options

Marking this thread — I’ll take the lead on the quote. Preliminary plan below; I’ll push a formal PDF quote + short two-slide pricing appendix by EOD Wed: 

Option A (12mo commit)
- List price: $1,250 / 1M tokens
- Committed discount: 72% (volume + startup sweetener applied), effective blended = $350 / 1M
- Founder credit: one-time $12k invoice credit applied in invoice month 1 and month 2 (phased)
- Minimum spend commitment: $420k over 12 months (pay-as-invoice monthly, PO ok)

Option B (24mo commit)
- List price: $1,250 / 1M tokens
- Committed discount: 78% (longer commitment + slot reservation), effective blended = $280 / 1M year 1 equivalent
- Founder credit: $18k one-time credit applied across first quarter
- Minimum spend commitment: $650k over 24 months (structured quarterly invoicing options)

Pilot fallback (6mo)
- No long-term commit; discounted trial rate = $600 / 1M; month-to-month invoicing.

Notes for procurement/legal: we will include standard SOW language, SOC2 attestation pointer, and a clause for reserved slot fallback if they need guaranteed throughput. Payment terms: default 30 days net; Marcus — call out if we need to push to 45d.

Attachments to follow: draft-commit-quote.pdf (formal quote), two-slide-pricing-appendix.pdf

Ben Carter
